title: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
intro: Use this page to submit privacy opt-out requests where applicable, including California and state privacy choices related to sale, sharing, cross-context behavioral advertising, analytics, or similar privacy rights.
html:
Privacy Choice

Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

Cognera Health does not sell PHI. Cognera Health does not sell personal information for money.

Where applicable law defines "sharing" to include certain cross-context behavioral advertising, targeted advertising, analytics, or similar activities, Cognera Health shall provide required opt-out mechanisms and honor applicable privacy choices.

Health data commitment: Cognera Health does not sell PHI, ePHI, or identifiable consumer health data. Cognera Health does not use PHI for advertising and does not share identifiable health data for cross-context behavioral advertising, third-party advertising, targeted advertising, or data broker disclosure.

Health Data Restrictions

Protected Health and Sensitive Data

Cognera Health does not use PHI/ePHI, clinical records, behavioral health information, mental health information, voice journaling content, assessment responses, treatment documentation, crisis-related information, or identifiable consumer health data for third-party advertising, targeted advertising, ad personalization, data broker disclosure, or sale.

Cognera Health limits the collection, use, disclosure, retention, and sharing of sensitive personal information consistent with applicable privacy laws, healthcare regulations, contractual obligations, security requirements, and legitimate business purposes.

Privacy commitment: Opt-out requests are reviewed under applicable privacy laws, contracts, healthcare obligations, and Cognera Health privacy governance practices.

Global Privacy Control

Global Privacy Control (GPC)

Where required by applicable law, Cognera Health recognizes browser-based privacy preference signals, including Global Privacy Control (GPC), and will process applicable requests consistent with legal obligations, technical feasibility, identity context, healthcare requirements, and contractual obligations.

Because some Cognera Health services operate in authenticated healthcare or enterprise environments, additional identity verification or in-product privacy controls are required before a GPC or opt-out signal can be applied to a specific account or regulated data context.

Sensitive Personal Information

Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information

Where applicable privacy laws provide a right to limit the use or disclosure of sensitive personal information, Cognera Health shall honor eligible requests consistent with healthcare obligations, security needs, customer instructions, legal requirements, and permitted business purposes.

Sensitive personal information includes health-related data, account identifiers, authentication data, precise information collected for security or service delivery, or other categories defined by applicable law.

Eligible Requests

What You Can Request

Do Not Sell

Request that Cognera Health not sell personal information where applicable law provides this right.

Do Not Share

Request opt-out of sharing as defined by applicable state privacy laws, including certain cross-context behavioral advertising activities where applicable.

Limit Sensitive Data

Submit privacy choices related to sensitive personal information or consumer health data where applicable.

Verification

Identity Verification and Request Routing

Cognera Health shall require reasonable verification of identity, account ownership, authorized agent status, organizational affiliation, or legal authority before applying privacy choices to account-specific data or regulated healthcare information.

Where Cognera Health acts as a Business Associate, certain privacy choices shall be routed to the applicable Covered Entity, healthcare provider, or enterprise customer.

Process

How Cognera Health Reviews Opt-Out Requests

California residents and other eligible individuals shall submit privacy requests through the privacy contact listed below, through in-product privacy controls, or through this designated privacy request form.

  • Submit the opt-out form, use available in-product privacy controls, or email Privacy.
  • Cognera Health reviews the request and verifies eligibility or authority where required.
  • Applicable opt-out choices are applied to eligible systems and vendor processes where required by law.
  • Cognera Health does not discriminate against individuals for exercising applicable privacy rights.
  • Legal, healthcare, contractual, security, fraud prevention, and compliance exceptions apply.

State Privacy Rights
